# Migration Intentions - v1.1.0

## Intentions

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:begin — generated by `pnpm boilerplate intentions sync`, do not edit -->

- [`00-adopt-conventional-commits.md`](./00-adopt-conventional-commits.md) — `migration` · `ci` — The project writes Conventional Commits, lints them locally with lefthook and commitlint, lints pull request title and description in CI, and squash-merges so the pull request title plus description become the commit that lands on `main`.
- [`01-adopt-feature-flag-helper.md`](./01-adopt-feature-flag-helper.md) — `migration` · `api` — The API can ship a merged change dark with one helper, `isFeatureEnabled`, reading `FEATURE_<NAME>` from the environment (`true` or `1` only). Unknown flags are off and are not added to the Zod env schema.
- [`02-adopt-release-please.md`](./02-adopt-release-please.md) — `migration` · `ci` — The project versions with release-please: a Release PR bumps the version and regenerates `CHANGELOG.md` from conventional squash commits, a short note in the docs app explains why that version exists, and a `v*` tag builds versioned GHCR images for every runnable app. — requires `v1.1.0/adopt-conventional-commits`
- [`03-adopt-typescript-6.md`](./03-adopt-typescript-6.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — The project compiles with TypeScript 6.0.x, sets `ignoreDeprecations: "6.0"` wherever `baseUrl` is used, and allows `typescript@6` through pnpm peer-dependency rules.
- [`04-align-shared-dependency-versions.md`](./04-align-shared-dependency-versions.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — Every catalog family the project shares with this boilerplate release is either raised to that release's tested version set, or explicitly pinned older in the project's catalogs with a named reason. — requires `v1.1.0/adopt-typescript-6`
- [`05-drop-pnpm-deploy-legacy.md`](./05-drop-pnpm-deploy-legacy.md) — `migration` · `ci` — Production Dockerfiles that run `pnpm deploy` do it without `--legacy`, and pass `--config.inject-workspace-packages=true` on that command so catalog peer dependencies still resolve.
- [`06-migrate-react-router-8.md`](./06-migrate-react-router-8.md) — `migration` · `frontend` — SPA, SSR, and the shared UI package depend on React Router 8.3, and route `meta` / `useMatches` read `loaderData` instead of the removed `data` field.
- [`07-pin-cookie-override-for-hoist.md`](./07-pin-cookie-override-for-hoist.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — Under a shamefully-hoisted pnpm layout, Express and Astro agree on `cookie@1.1.1`, and the documentation app stays on Astro 7.1.1.
- [`08-point-knip-at-auth-cli-mts.md`](./08-point-knip-at-auth-cli-mts.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — Knip's API workspace entry for the Better Auth CLI script points at `src/modules/auth/auth.cli.mts`, matching the file that actually exists.
- [`09-unify-i18n-language-keys.md`](./09-unify-i18n-language-keys.md) — `migration` · `frontend` — `@boilerstone/i18n` (and SPA/SSR consumers) identify languages as `en` | `fr`. `htmlLang` carries the BCP-47 tag for `<html lang>`. Legacy `fr-FR` / `en-GB` cookie and localStorage values normalize on read.

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:end -->
